description: This file defines the ITransactionalResourceExtension interface, which specifies methods for transactional resource management in Orleans, including commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare operations with transaction annotations.

classes.name: ITransactionalResourceExtension
classes.description: An interface extending IGrainExtension, providing methods for transactional resource operations with transaction control annotations.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Performs a read-only commit operation for a resource within a transaction, returning the transactional status.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts a transaction for a specified resource.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a transaction for a resource, providing a timestamp and transactional status.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction for a resource at a given timestamp.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares a resource for a transaction, with access count, timestamp, and transaction manager participant ID.
